quote: Lemma 4 (Li and Fang [17]) For two n-dimensional Archimedean copulas C_psi1(u) and C_psi2(u), with phi_2 = psi_2^{-1} = sup{x in R : psi(x) > u} as the right continuous inverse, if phi_2 o psi_1 is super-additive, then C_psi1(u) <= C_psi2(u) for all u in [0,1]^n. Recall that a function f is said to be super-additive if f(x + y) >= f(x) + f(y) for all x and y in the domain of f.
